title: Denmark approves new grid connection prioritization model

title: Italian startup unveils double-layer PV system prototype for space-constrained applications
content:
Italian startup AMPS has developed a double-layer PV system that dynamically manages two overlapping module surfaces to increase solar-energy capture without expanding the installation footprint. The company says initial field tests showed short-circuit current-based gains of up to 27% over a comparable single-layer bifacial system, with utility-scale and agrivoltaic applications now under development.

title: Agrivoltaics improve grapevine growth, biodiversity in hot Mediterranean climates
content:
Researchers studying an agrivoltaic vineyard in southern Italy have found that shading from PV modules can promote grapevine growth, increase bunch weight and support spontaneous plant biodiversity, while also moderating vineyard temperatures. The researchers caution, however, that the results are strongly dependent on local climate and crop characteristics.

title: Hybrid PV cooling system boosts electrical efficiency by 26%, provides building ventilation
content:
Researchers have developed a hybrid PV cooling system that combines rear-side evaporative cooling with intermittent front-side water spraying, increasing electrical efficiency by up to 26%. The system also produces precooled ventilation air, offering potential for reducing building cooling loads in hot, arid climates.
